notes: lema'an 'asher is divided as rule 55's own corpus example directs: to the end on the preposition, headed on end by rule 24, and that on the relative.
even that is read as one rendering of the waw under rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator clause, headed on the coordinator; the competing reading leaves that added.
The for of for sacrifices of peace offerings goes to the bare nominal under rule 33, not to the verb under rule 44, because the English verb's own object is the them of 'otam.
